people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Hepher
people.line: Son of Gilead, ancestor of the Hepherites.

people.name: Hoglah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Mahlah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, who received an inheritance among her brothers.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Milcah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, a descendant of Manasseh.

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights

people.name: Zelophehad
people.line: Israelite whose daughters received his inheritance

translations.web: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.bsb: But Zelophehad son of Hepher (the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh) had no sons but only daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.asv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
